sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, on 15.05.2023, 25 years old prosecutrix along with her mother appeared at Police Station Maharajpur and submitted an application in writing that on 19.04.2023 she along with her aunt had gone to cook food at Primary School Jhikmau.
After cooking meal she distributed the same to the children and came back to home.
At around 11:00 A.M. to collect her Adhar Card and to deposit the money she was preparing to left for Maharajpur but her sister-in-law asked her to tie the buffalo with the wedge.
When she went in the back side of the house she found her buffalo missing.
When in search of buffalo she reached on the other side of river, she saw two boys who were wearing masks on their faces.
When she came to them one of them was Sunil Rajak of the village and she had never seen the another boy.
They both forcibly got her sit on the motorcycle.
The another boy was being called by the name 'Raja'.
After sometime, she found herself in a room and her lower was not on her body.
Even her Kurta was above her chest and she was having pain in her private parts.
When she asked Sunil that he has committed wrong with her Sunil and his friend threatened and asked to keep quiet.
Thereafter, they continuously raped her.
They got her signatures on papers.
Sunil and Raja repeatedly committed rape upon her.
On 14.05.2023 she took out Rs.1,000/- from the pocket of Sunil and reached Nizamudin Railway station and from train she reached Mahoba.
FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix was having love affair with him.
She on her own had gone with the applicant.
They had entered into wedlock but now under the pressure of the family members a false FIR has been lodged.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
5 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
6 . In this case, prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
Now, there is no possibility of influencing of prosecution witness and tempering with the prosecution evidence.

Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that final conclusion of trial will take considerable time, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7 . It is directed that applicant - Sunil Shrivas (Rajak) be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
